newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: U.S. Defence Secretary Perry in Bahrain.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Defence Secretary Perry in Bahrain.

text.p: U.S. Defence Secretary William Perry arrived in Bahrain from Kuwait on Sunday on the third leg of a regional tour to drum up Arab support for U.S. policy towards Iraq.
Officials said Perry was met at the airport by Defence Minister Sheikh Khalifa bin Ahmad al-Khalifa, before going to see the Emir Sheikh Isa bin Sulman al-Khalifa.

Perry is on a visit to the Gulf to try to rally the Gulf War alliance against Iraqi President Saddam Hussein following his incursion against Kurdish rebels in northern Iraq and missile attacks on U.S. planes patrolling a no-fly zone.
A U.S. official said Perry would go back to Saudi Arabia later on Sunday to meet King Fahd. Perry was in Saudi Arabia for a few hours on Sunday morning.
